description: Literal substring search over product title, brand name and model number. Optional category, price and rating filters and explicit sort orders are supported. Natural-language and similarity search are not supported.

category_id.description: optional category_id or subcategory_id from list_categories

query.description: 1 to 8 literal terms; title, brand or model match

sort.description: price_asc, price_desc, rating_desc or review_count_desc; omit for relevance order

name: search_products
title: Search Products
